A '''Jedi recruiter''' was one of the most unpopular [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] throughout its history, garnering the bulk of the [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi sentiment]] that plagued the citizenship of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] periodically.

==Overview==
A specialized field of study undertaken by those [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] that desired to become a [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]], most Recruiters were retired [[Jedi investigator/Legends|Jedi investigators]], turning their [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] of tracking and detection to locate unrecognized [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].

Working as members of the [[Acquisition Division/Legends|Acquisition Division]], recruiters studied the data turned over from Republic [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenters]] and the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]] in order to track down potential recruits. During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], Jedi recruiters (particularly those who opposed the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council's]] decision to remain neutral during the conflict) covertly made their way to the front lines to assist the Republic military. During the [[New Sith Wars]], they sought Force-sensitives to recruit into the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] before the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] could discover their location. [[Torr Snapit]] was among their ranks.

In an attempt to maintain some uniformity amongst the recruiters and all Jedi, the High Council demanded that all positions in the Order be codified and new rules enforced. Following the passage of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], Recruiter [[Morrit Ch'gally/Legends|Morrit Ch'gally]] authored the section on ''Enlisting New Members'' within the pages of the handbook dubbed ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. Meant to draw the interest of those [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] who wished to use their knowledge as an investigator, the pages also outlined the duties of the Acquisition Division and its members.<ref name="TJP" />
